reports.title: XERIS BIOPHARMA REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS AND BUSINESS HIGHLIGHTS

lines: Raises full-year 2026 total revenue guidance to $395 million to $405 million
Raises 2030 total revenue outlook to more than $1 billion, up from approximately $750 million

“As a biopharmaceutical leader in endocrine and rare diseases, our strong third quarter performance puts us on a new growth curve that is accelerating our Company’s near-term outlook, and we are now on a path to reach more than $1 billion in total revenue in 2030," said John Shannon, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Xeris.
Given the strong momentum across Recorlev, Gvoke, and Keveyis, we are raising our full-year total revenue guidance to $395–$405 million.”
